key_insight: OxiGen adds explicit oxidation states to crystal diffusion generation, improving chemical realism while enforcing exact charge neutrality.
engineering_relevance: This makes inverse design for inorganic materials more practical by generating candidate crystals that are more likely to be synthetically and compositionally valid.
method: Oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that represents oxidation states during generation.
Structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton to guarantee global charge neutrality.
Supports property-conditioned generation while preserving compositional validity.
evidence_signal: According to the abstract, OxiGen improves oxidation-state fidelity and achieves the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, while maintaining high validity under property conditioning.
watch_item: Exact inference and structured decoding may add implementation complexity and could make scaling or integration with other generative pipelines less straightforward.
